verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's first-party webhooks documentation says it sends notifications any time an event happens in your app, and its GitHub README confirms real-time event notification through webhooks. That is the product's own outbound callback capability, not a chat-app integration. Missing for 10: documented endpoint registration/configuration steps, event types and payload schema, delivery guarantees (retries, signing/auth), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
